## 🎯 Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a specific challenge or pain point? Please describe clearly.  
*(e.g., "I get distracted when trying to review notes while keeping the video centered...")*

## 🚀 Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.  
*(e.g., "Add a toggleable side-by-side split screen view in the Focus Room...")*

## 💡 Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions, features, or workarounds you've considered.

## 🧘 Distraction-Free Impact
How does this feature protect deep cognitive flow and prevent engagement-loop traps?

## ℹ️ Additional Context
Add any other context, wireframes, mockups, or inspiration screenshots here.
